fullContentHtml:
RSSB Agriculture Supervisor Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) has recently released the result for the recruitment of Agriculture Supervisor Posts on the official website of RSSB. This recruitment was released for 1100 posts. Applications for the RSSB Agriculture Supervisor Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 13 January 2026 to 11 February 2026. The written examination was held on 18 April 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their RSSB Agriculture Supervisor Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 06 January 2026
  • Application Start Date : 13 January 2026
  • Last Date : 11 February 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 11 February 2026
  • Correction Date : Upto 14 February 2026
  • Exam Date : 18 April 2026
  • Admit Card : 13 April 2026
  • Answer Key : 13 May 2026
  • Result : 23 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC (Creamy Layer) : Rs. 600/-
  • EWS , OBC (Non Creamy Layer) : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 400/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 300/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
